title: Sort a Nearly Sorted Array
statement:
A nearly sorted array (also called a K-sorted array) is one where every element is at most K positions away from its sorted position.

Given such an array and K, sort it efficiently using a min-heap of size K+1.

Print the sorted array.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers (nearly sorted, each element at most K away from sorted position).
outputFormat: N space-separated integers in sorted order.

examples.explanation: Each element is at most 3 positions away from its sorted position.
Sorted using a size-5 min-heap window.

starterCode.python:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here
# Hint: maintain a min-heap of size k+1; pop when heap size exceeds k
